normal.name: Anxious Division
normal.text: Road Rash was re-released for modern PC today. It's only $5 on both GOG and Steam. At first I was like, "I'll buy that" then I remembered it was an EA game. As far as I'm concerned, we already paid for it. I won't be installing that spyware on my system. Who the hell wants cloud saves in DRM-free?

normal.name: Skyyrizon
normal.text: An open question: If you could bring back one ordinary thing from your childhood, what would it be? Not necessarily a big experience. Maybe a snack you can’t find anymore, an old video game, a place you used to visit, or a Saturday morning routine. What would you choose?

normal.name: Action Kazimer
normal.text: Man, one of the best things about old games is hearing all the different ways people came up with to pronounce things. Skulatta is incredible--I remember my world being flipped when I met a friend that said "Chocobo" like "chocolate." I can even see why, it just never occurred to me, hahah.

normal.name: Puppy Vhiro
normal.text: got con crud bad but Zelda dropped and many childhood memories flashed thru my head. its one of my favorite games cuz its the last game i remember playing with my big sister before she passed away. I was so bad at puzzles so she let me sit on her lap while she beat the hard ones. miss you sis.
